action.description: get reads one trace's observations with fixed limit=200 and no pagination; requires id even when action is omitted. list reads one root-observation response page. update is unsupported.

id.description: Required for get: trace ID used as traceId query filter (not a field named traceId in these arguments). Ignored by list. Sent directly without URL encoding; use a query-safe ID.

userId.description: Optional list-only user filter, sent directly without URL encoding; use a query-safe value. Ignored by get.

limit.description: List-only page size, clamped to 1..1000; omitted sends no limit (server default). Ignored by get, which always uses limit=200. Neither action automatically paginates.
